explication: n8n-as-code provides editor and CLI workflows for authoring, validating, syncing, and operating n8n workflows, with AI-agent context and TypeScript workflow conversion. A typical path starts in VS Code or the CLI, uses an n8n environment, then pulls or authors workflow source, validates it, and explicitly pushes or promotes it. The graph includes the documented skills, MCP, and managed-instance capabilities. Several of those implementations were not sampled, so their links are limited to README-supported relationships.
